self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Sky-Piercing Fang (R1): after using Elemental Burst, Normal and Charged Attacks deal additional DMG equal to 20% of ATK for 12s. Movement SPD/ATK SPD bonuses not modeled (non-combat). Modeled as a supplementary hit — its own rotation target (weapon/normalExtraHit + weapon/chargedExtraHit), weight = how many times it procs; physical, scales with ATK, Physical DMG Bonus and CRIT only (no other DMG% bonuses). Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

en.flavor: The sword of a knight that symbolizes the restored honor of Dvalin. The blessings of the Anemo Archon rest on the fuller of the blade, imbuing the sword with the powers of the sky and the wind.

pt.flavor: A espada de um cavaleiro que simboliza a honra restaurada de Dvalin. As bênçãos do Arconte Anemo repousam sobre a lâmina mais cheia, imbuindo a espada com os poderes do céu e do vento.
